newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds steady in routine trade.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds steady in routine trade.

text.p: UK meals and feeds sellers were steady on Friday following gains in Chicago.
However, trading was mostly routine ahead of the weekend.
Most of the day's business was done just after the USDA released it's latest crop report which cut the soybean carryover by 125 million bushels.
"Many people saw the cut in the carryover and thought it was time to buy before Chicago went through the roof," said one broker.
However, although called to open 10 to 20 cents higher the U.S. market turned lower, after early gains, on weak crush data and long liquidation.
High protein soymeal ex-store Portbury fetched 225 stg a tonne for spot.
In the south west Argentine sunflower meal 32/33 percent protein traded at 97 stg for spot ex-store Teignmouth while on Humberside 90 stg was paid for spot 29 percent protein Argentine soymeal.
High protein soymeal sellers were around three stg higher ex-mill and store while Brazilian 48's were around two stg down.
The remainder of the market was unchanged.
